## Functions

### createMachineLinkPostChannel()

```ts
function createMachineLinkPostChannel(options): object;
```

One connection's bounded Post I/O, without an outbox, dedupe store or RPC
capability table. Native socket ownership and authentication stay with the host.
Reconstruct after hibernation when idle; close on disconnect/restart and let the
existing Carrier outbox retry the same frozen envelope.

Receipt payloads remain opaque. The Agent mail route still requires a real
Shiitake Accepted receipt; a generic Post acknowledgment is not one.

#### Parameters

| Parameter                         | Type                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| --------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `options`                         | \{ `send`: (`frame`) => `void` \| `Promise`\<`void`\>; `receive`: (`envelope`) => `Promise`\<`PostDeliveryResult`\>; `limits`: \{ `maxInFlight`: `number`; `maxFrameBytes`: `number`; `acknowledgmentMs`: `number`; \}; \} |
| `options.send`                    | (`frame`) => `void` \| `Promise`\<`void`\>                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `options.receive`                 | (`envelope`) => `Promise`\<`PostDeliveryResult`\>                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `options.limits`                  | \{ `maxInFlight`: `number`; `maxFrameBytes`: `number`; `acknowledgmentMs`: `number`; \}                                                                                                                                    |
| `options.limits.maxInFlight`      | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `options.limits.maxFrameBytes`    | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `options.limits.acknowledgmentMs` | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |

#### Returns

| Name        | Type                                              | Description                                                              |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `deliver()` | (`envelope`) => `Promise`\<`PostDeliveryResult`\> | Send now; never acknowledge custody before the receiver replies.         |
| `receive()` | (`text`) => `Promise`\<`void`\>                   | Called only for a host-authenticated, current native socket.             |
| `close()`   | () => `void`                                      | Forget only pending I/O. The durable sender still owns undelivered work. |
